candidates.topic: Sun in Libra + Mercury in Libra — Double Libra Energy
candidates.teaser: Two major planets are stacked in the same sign right now — and it's quietly reshaping every conversation you're having.
candidates.video_title: Sun & Mercury Both in Libra — What's Really Happening
candidates.video_description: The Sun sits at 5.7° Libra while Mercury is all the way at 27.8° Libra — they're in the same sign but miles apart in energy. This creates a rare tension between who you are and how you communicate. Here's what that split means for you.
candidates.script: Two planets in the same sign doesn't mean the same energy — it means a conversation with itself. Right now the Sun is at 5° Libra and Mercury is almost at 28°, nearly out the door. Astrologers read this as your identity still settling into Libra themes — balance, fairness, connection — while your mind is already racing ahead. You're thinking faster than you're feeling. Which one is actually leading you right now?

candidates.topic: Mars into Leo — Cardinal Fire Meets Fixed Fire
candidates.teaser: Mars just entered a new sign — and depending on your chart, this shift either charges you up or completely burns you out.
candidates.video_title: Mars at 0° Leo — The Energy Just Flipped
candidates.video_description: Mars moved into Leo and sits at just 0.4° — brand new in this sign. In astrology, a planet at 0° is raw, unfiltered, and unpredictable. Leo Mars wants recognition, action, and drama. Here's who feels it most.
candidates.script: Mars just stepped into Leo — and at 0° it hasn't learned to control itself yet. In astrology, a planet at zero degrees is pure impulse. Leo Mars wants to be seen, wants to lead, wants the spotlight — and right now that energy is completely unfiltered. Fire signs feel this like rocket fuel. Water signs feel it like an uncomfortable pressure to perform. The question is: are you ready to be witnessed, or are you still hiding?

candidates.topic: Waning Gibbous Moon in Taurus Opposite Sun in Libra
candidates.teaser: The Moon and the Sun are in a quiet tug-of-war right now — and it's showing up in your body before your mind even notices.
candidates.video_title: Moon in Taurus vs. Sun in Libra — Inner Conflict
candidates.video_description: A Waning Gibbous Moon in Taurus sits opposite the Libra Sun — earth energy pulling toward comfort and stillness while Libra pushes for social balance and connection. Astrologers often read this opposition as a tension between what you need and what others need from you.
candidates.script: Your body is telling you one thing and your relationships are demanding another — and that's not random. The Waning Gibbous Moon is in Taurus right now, pulling you toward rest, comfort, stillness. But the Sun in Libra is pushing for connection, compromise, showing up for others. Astrologers call this an opposition — two energies at maximum tension. The release phase of the moon says let go. But let go of what, exactly? That's the real question this week.

candidates.teaser: There's one degree in astrology that almost nobody talks about — and if a planet hits it in your chart, everything speeds up fast.
candidates.video_title: The 29th Degree — Astrology's Most Intense Point
candidates.video_description: The anaretic degree — 29° of any sign — is considered a critical pressure point in astrology. Planets there are said to carry the full unresolved tension of that sign before moving on. It appears in birth charts, transits, and progressions, and astrologers consistently flag it as a point of urgency.
candidates.script: The 29th degree of any sign is called the anaretic degree — and in astrology it's treated like a deadline. A planet here has exhausted everything that sign has to offer and hasn't made the transition yet. Astrologers describe it as maximum pressure, urgency, unfinished business demanding resolution. If you have a planet at 29° in your birth chart, that energy doesn't sit still. It either forces a decision or creates a crisis. Which planet is yours sitting on the edge?

candidates.topic: Venus in Scorpio Trine Saturn Retrograde in Aries — Rare Aspect
candidates.teaser: Venus and Saturn are forming a rare angle right now — and astrologers say this is the one transit that actually makes love feel real instead of just exciting.
candidates.video_title: Venus Trine Saturn — When Love Gets Serious
candidates.video_description: Venus at 8.1° Scorpio forms a trine with Saturn retrograde at 11.7° Aries — a fire-water trine that astrologers associate with emotional depth meeting structural commitment. Saturn retrograde adds an internal dimension: this isn't about new relationships forming, it's about evaluating the ones already in place.
candidates.script: Venus in Scorpio and Saturn retrograde in Aries are forming a trine right now — and this is the aspect astrologers say separates real connection from surface-level attraction. Scorpio Venus wants intensity, loyalty, depth. Saturn retrograde asks: is this actually built to last, or are you just addicted to the feeling? Trines are considered flowing aspects, so this isn't a crisis — it's a quiet moment of clarity. Whatever relationship is on your mind right now? This week gives you the answer.
